bio.text: Michelle Fischbach represents Minnesota's 7th District in the U.S. House of Representatives, which she joined in 2021, and serves on the Ways and Means and Rules committees.

She was elected to the Minnesota Senate in a 1996 special election and served until 2018, becoming President of the Minnesota Senate in 2011, and later served as the 49th Lieutenant Governor of Minnesota.
She received a B.A. in Political Science from St. Cloud State University and a J.D. from William Mitchell College of Law.
